verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents x402 by name in its own docs. The CDP SDK supports both paying for resources and charging for endpoints, and the Agentic Wallet CLI and MCP tools add pay-for-service (with a max-amount cap), payment-requirement checks and x402 service discovery. This clearly meets the story's bar of documented SDKs and endpoints rather than a blog aspiration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 integration, and no evidence of the other named protocols (ACP, MPP, AP2).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform speaks the machine-payment protocols by name — x402, ACP, MPP, or AP2 support documented with endpoints or SDKs, not just a blog aspiration
